description: Space Exploration: union of seven extremity tails, each tuned to about 1 universe in 10,000 on an unfiltered sample (seeds 2,000,000,000..2,001,000,000 = 500,000 universes). Keeps both the best and the worst end of each metric. The low end of the body count is deliberately not a tail: that distribution has a hard floor at 13 and piles up there, so a low cutoff is not rare. Expected to keep about 1 universe in 1,500 (~1.4M seeds over the full range).

meaning.PLANETS_HIGH: home-system planets + moons at least this many
meaning.NAQ_DV_LOW: nearest naquium-primary asteroid field within this travel delta-v
meaning.NAQ_DV_HIGH: nearest asteroid field of any kind at least this far
meaning.ENEMY_PCT_LOW: at most this % of home-system bodies have enemies
meaning.ENEMY_PCT_HIGH: at least this % of home-system bodies have enemies
meaning.WATER_PCT_LOW: at most this % of home-system bodies have water
meaning.WATER_PCT_HIGH: at least this % of home-system bodies have water
